question: Approve the launcher fix (spacedock claude sets CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS=0 unless set, passed through Safehouse; +51 net, 8 files) and replace the seed AC with 'the worker is not stopped before it reports'?

artifacts.summary: Cause confirmed by 7 Haiku host probes: in -p mode Claude Code 2.1.303 stops background agents after CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS (default 600000) of main-turn idleness; each FO turn resets it; 0 lets a worker report 663 s later and wake the FO. The FO contract's end_turn-and-wait posture is correct. Fix: spacedock claude sets the variable to 0 unless the operator set it, with --env-pass under Safehouse; the live harness launches through spacedock claude, so it is covered. Rejected: FO wait rule (no blocking tool, sleep banned), ensign stage-size rule, harness-only env. Risks: a never-ending background agent now never exits; the variable is undocumented. Needs decision: seed AC change. 0 Sonnet runs used.
